benchmarkNote: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: higher is better. AA rank: lower is better within that model page's comparison class; ranks across different classes are not directly comparable.

models.label: GPT-6 Luna
models.description: A low-cost, large-context reasoning model suited to routine professional work where responsiveness and cost matter.
models.goodFor: Email, summarisation, extraction, routine analysis, everyday Office work, document transformation and routine coding.
models.limitations: For difficult research, high-value synthesis or the hardest coding and analytical work, use a frontier model instead.

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.description: Anthropic's frontier model, with particularly strong independent results on long-horizon knowledge work, scientific coding and complex professional tasks.
models.goodFor: Research, complex analysis, important articles and reports, difficult coding, presentation planning and high-value synthesis.
models.limitations: Much more expensive and potentially more verbose than the everyday model; use it when the quality benefit matters.

models.label: GPT-6 Astra
models.description: OpenAI's frontier reasoning model, designed for difficult technical, agentic and professional-document workloads.
models.goodFor: Deep technical work, long professional documents, difficult reasoning, complex automation and an alternative frontier perspective to Opus.
models.limitations: Expensive and comparatively slow; it is unnecessary for routine drafting, summarisation or simple analysis.

models.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.description: A fast open-weight reasoning model with strong cost/performance and a large context window.
models.goodFor: High-volume drafting, iterative analysis, research support and workloads where speed and cost matter.
models.limitations: Our qualification should continue to watch instruction discipline and verbosity on strict-output or long-running tasks.

changelog.title: Initial signed beta catalogue
changelog.body: Introduces GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the first remotely managed WRN candidate set.
